newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Banks see zloty at 2.8735 vs dlr end-96.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Banks see zloty at 2.8735 vs dlr end-96.

text.p: The Polish zloty is seen easing against the dollar by year-end and the prediction is more pessimistic than last month, according to a Reuter poll of the country's 25 largest banks.

By the end of 1996, the zloty is expected to fall to 2.8735 to the dollar versus Monday's fixing of 2.8580, the poll showed. The 2.8735 rate is a mean average of forecasts that ranged between 2.8350 and 2.9095.
In the same poll a year ago, banks predicted the zloty would fall to an average of 2.8282 against the dollar with a range of forecasts from 2.5470 to 3.000.
Last month, banks had predicted a fall in the Polish unit to 2.8553 at year-end. Forecasts ranged from 2.8050 to 2.9000.
Banks estimated the zloty would fall to an average of 3.1940 to the dollar in December 1997 with a range of forecasts from 3.0500 to 3.5000.
